description.value: Trickle Creek Lodge is a year-round, ski-in/ski-out and golf-in/golf-out resort hotel at the base of Kimberley Alpine Resort, offering 80 suites with full kitchens, gas fireplaces, and views of the Rocky Mountains or the ski slopes. The Kimberley Alpine Resort high-speed quad chairlift is just steps from the hotel's back door, and the property sits near the Peak to Plaza trail network popular with hikers and cyclists. Touring cyclists will find a full-service hotel experience including on-site dining, a heated outdoor pool and hot tubs, underground parking, and guest laundry.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is complete and corroborates all OSM contact details exactly. The amenities page lists 'Ski/Snowboard Equipment Storage' but makes no explicit mention of bike-specific secure storage, so that criterion remains null. Wi-Fi, guest laundry, on-site restaurant/lounge, and a convenience store are all explicitly confirmed on the amenities page.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, year-round resort hotel confirmed by active website and consistent contact details. Clear value to touring cyclists as a full-service accommodation near trail networks.
enrichment_extras.notes: The amenities page lists 'Ski/Snowboard Equipment Storage' which may serve bikes off-season, but no explicit bicycle storage is mentioned. A direct inquiry could confirm this. Toll-free reservations number (1-877-282-1200) differs from the local/OSM number (250-427-5175); both are legitimate contact numbers for the same property.
